name: node_api
description: Build a Node.js/Express REST API with JWT auth, SQLite via better-sqlite3, and Zod validation.
steps: Create project structure: src/, src/routes/, src/middleware/, src/db/, src/schemas/
Write package.json with express, better-sqlite3, jsonwebtoken, bcryptjs, zod, dotenv
Write src/db/database.js with SQLite setup and schema creation
Write src/middleware/auth.js with JWT verification middleware
Write src/middleware/validate.js with Zod schema validation middleware
Write src/schemas/ Zod schemas for each resource
Write src/routes/ Express routers for each resource
Write src/app.js with Express app setup, middleware, and route mounting
Write src/index.js entry point with server listen
Run: node src/index.js to verify startup
best_practices: Use ES modules (type: module in package.json) with import/export
Validate all input with Zod before processing
Use async/await with try/catch — avoid callback style
Return JSON with consistent shape: {success, data, error}
Use 422 for validation errors, 401 for auth, 403 for forbidden
Environment variables via dotenv — never hardcode secrets
Add request logging with a simple middleware
system_prompt_injection: You are building a Node.js Express API. Use ES modules. Create ALL files in the steps. Write complete, working JavaScript. After creating files, run npm install then node src/index.js to verify startup. Fix any errors before finishing.
